payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the original blue mug from the source visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED, tracking the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones in SOURCE by its visible appearance and context. Fulfillment requires that this same mug—not a different or newly appearing mug—be visibly positioned to the right of the headphones. A white mug on the right does not establish fulfillment. Award partial only if the images provide concrete evidence that the tracked source mug itself moved toward the right of the headphones but has not reached that position. A blue blurred patch remaining at the source location, without evidence that the source mug moved, is not progress. If the source mug's identity or movement cannot be determined, treat the evidence as insufficient rather than inferring either movement or no movement.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: compare that mug's visible appearance and context across images. The edited image shows a blue blurred patch at the former left-side location and white mugs, one to the right of the headphones; do not treat the patch as proof of movement or either white mug as the source mug without visual continuity evidence.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
condition.zero_when: There is no concrete visual evidence that the source blue mug moved toward the right of the headphones; a different mug on the right or a blue blurred remnant at the source location alone does not count.
condition.half_when: The source blue mug is visibly tracked and has moved toward the right of the headphones, but remains short of being positioned to their right, with a concrete remaining positional deficiency.
condition.full_when: The source blue mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image.
